key_insight: Computing total deformation from particle positions and a fixed reference grid enables perfectly elastic MPM solids to recover from large deformations without numerical fracture while retaining current-grid force evaluation.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports simulation of highly deformable elastic components with contact using standard grid-based collision handling.
method: Compute deformation directly from particle positions relative to a fixed reference grid, rather than updating it through velocity gradients.
Evaluate elastic forces on the current grid to retain compatibility with standard MPM collision handling.
Support particle-level collision handling and zero-energy mode suppression to counter nonlinear deformation artifacts.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports efficient simulations of complex elastic objects undergoing large deformations and contact, but provides no quantitative benchmarks.
watch_item: Implementation must coordinate reference-grid deformation evaluation, current-grid forces, and stabilization; the abstract does not quantify their computational overhead.
paper_title: Total Deformation-based MPM for Perfectly Elastic Solid Simulation with Strong Deformations
